				<script>
			function openSelectLink(select) {
				if (select.value) {
					window.open(select.value, '_blank');
				}
				select.selectedIndex = 0;
			}

			function search() {
				var input = document.getElementById('searchTitle');
				var key = input ? input.value.trim() : '';
				if (key === '')
					alert('请输入关键字');
				else
					location.href = '/News/Search?keywords=' + encodeURIComponent(key);
			}

			function setHomepage() {
				var url = window.location.href;
				try {
					document.documentElement.style.behavior = 'url(#default#homepage)';
					document.documentElement.setHomePage(url);
				} catch (e) {
					if (navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase().indexOf('msie') > -1) {
						document.execCommand('setHomePage', false, url);
					} else {
						alert('您好，您的浏览器不支持自动设置首页。请您手动将「' + url + '」设置为首页。');
					}
				}
			}

			function addBookmark() {
				var url = window.location.href;
				var title = document.title;
				try {
					if (window.external && window.external.addFavorite) {
						window.external.addFavorite(url, title);
					} else if (window.sidebar && window.sidebar.addPanel) {
						window.sidebar.addPanel(title, url, '');
					} else {
						prompt('请按 Ctrl+D 键，将「' + title + '」添加到收藏夹。\n\n或者复制以下地址手动添加到收藏夹：', url);
					}
				} catch (e) {
					prompt('请按 Ctrl+D 键，将「' + title + '」添加到收藏夹。\n\n或者复制以下地址手动添加到收藏夹：', url);
				}
			}

			function selectExam(id) {
				var panel = document.querySelector('.exam-panel[data-exam="' + id + '"]');
				if (!panel) return;

				if (history.pushState) {
					history.pushState(null, '', '#exam-' + id);
				} else {
					location.hash = 'exam-' + id;
				}

				document.querySelectorAll('#examTypesList li[data-id]').forEach(function(li) {
					li.classList.toggle('active', li.dataset.id === id);
				});

				document.querySelectorAll('.exam-panel').forEach(function(p) {
					p.classList.toggle('active', p.dataset.exam === id);
				});

				document.getElementById('examName').textContent = panel.dataset.name || '';
				var englishEl = document.getElementById('examEnglishName');
				if (englishEl) englishEl.textContent = panel.dataset.en || '';
				document.getElementById('examDesc').textContent = panel.dataset.desc || '';
				goConsultPage(id, 1);
			}

			var ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 8;
			var CONSULT_YEARS = 5;
			var consultPageState = {};

			function parseConsultDate(text) {
				if (!text) return null;
				var match = String(text).trim().match(/(\d{4})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})/);
				if (!match) return null;
				return new Date(parseInt(match[1], 10), parseInt(match[2], 10) - 1, parseInt(match[3], 10));
			}

			function filterConsultItemsByRecentYears(items, years) {
				if (!items.length) return items;
				var dated = items.map(function(item) {
					var dateEl = item.querySelector('.consult-date');
					return { item: item, date: dateEl ? parseConsultDate(dateEl.textContent) : null };
				}).filter(function(entry) { return entry.date; });
				if (!dated.length) return items;
				var cutoff = new Date();
				cutoff.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
				cutoff.setFullYear(cutoff.getFullYear() - years);
				var oldest = dated.reduce(function(min, entry) {
					return entry.date < min ? entry.date : min;
				}, dated[0].date);
				if (oldest >= cutoff) {
					return items;
				}
				return items.filter(function(item) {
					var dateEl = item.querySelector('.consult-date');
					var date = dateEl ? parseConsultDate(dateEl.textContent) : null;
					return date && date >= cutoff;
				});
			}

			function renderConsultPagination(examId, page) {
				var state = consultPageState[examId];
				if (!state) return;
				var totalPages = state.totalPages;
				page = Math.max(1, Math.min(page, totalPages));
				state.currentPage = page;

				state.items.forEach(function(item, index) {
					var visible = index >= (page - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE && index < page * ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
					item.classList.toggle('page-hidden', !visible);
				});

				var pag = state.pagEl;
				pag.innerHTML = '';

				var prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
				prevBtn.type = 'button';
				prevBtn.className = 'pagination-btn';
				prevBtn.textContent = '上一页';
				prevBtn.disabled = page === 1;
				prevBtn.onclick = function() { goConsultPage(examId, page - 1); };
				pag.appendChild(prevBtn);

				var maxVisible = 5;
				var startPage = Math.max(1, page - Math.floor(maxVisible / 2));
				var endPage = Math.min(totalPages, startPage + maxVisible - 1);
				if (endPage - startPage < maxVisible - 1) {
					startPage = Math.max(1, endPage - maxVisible + 1);
				}
				for (var i = startPage; i <= endPage; i++) {
					(function(pageNum) {
						var pageBtn = document.createElement('button');
						pageBtn.type = 'button';
						pageBtn.className = 'pagination-btn' + (pageNum === page ? ' active' : '');
						pageBtn.textContent = pageNum;
						pageBtn.onclick = function() { goConsultPage(examId, pageNum); };
						pag.appendChild(pageBtn);
					})(i);
				}

				var nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
				nextBtn.type = 'button';
				nextBtn.className = 'pagination-btn';
				nextBtn.textContent = '下一页';
				nextBtn.disabled = page === totalPages;
				nextBtn.onclick = function() { goConsultPage(examId, page + 1); };
				pag.appendChild(nextBtn);

				var info = document.createElement('span');
				info.className = 'pagination-info';
				info.textContent = '共 ' + totalPages + ' 页 / ' + state.items.length + ' 条';
				pag.appendChild(info);
			}

			function goConsultPage(examId, page) {
				renderConsultPagination(examId, page);
			}

			function initConsultPagination() {
				document.querySelectorAll('.exam-panel').forEach(function(panel) {
					var examId = panel.dataset.exam;
					var wrapper = panel.querySelector('.consult-wrapper');
					if (!wrapper) return;
					var allItems = Array.from(wrapper.querySelectorAll('.consult-list .consult-item'));
					var items = filterConsultItemsByRecentYears(allItems, CONSULT_YEARS);
					allItems.forEach(function(item) {
						if (items.indexOf(item) === -1) {
							item.classList.add('page-hidden');
							item.style.display = 'none';
						}
					});
					var pagEl = wrapper.querySelector('.pagination');
					if (!pagEl || items.length === 0) return;
					consultPageState[examId] = {
						items: items,
						pagEl: pagEl,
						totalPages: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(items.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE)),
						currentPage: 1
					};
					renderConsultPagination(examId, 1);
				});
			}

			function handleHash() {
				var hash = window.location.hash.replace('#', '');
				if (hash.startsWith('exam-')) {
					var id = hash.replace('exam-', '');
					if (document.querySelector('.exam-panel[data-exam="' + id + '"]')) {
						selectExam(id);
						return;
					}
				}
				selectExam('gaokao');
			}

			window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleHash);
			document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
				lucide.createIcons();
				initConsultPagination();
				handleHash();
			});
		</script>
	</body>
</html>
